prompt:
A student measures the diameter of a uniform glass marble five times using a micrometer screw gauge and records:
16.34 mm, 16.36 mm, 16.35 mm, 16.34 mm, 16.35 mm.
(a) Calculate the range of the measurements. [1]
(b) State and explain whether these measurements demonstrate high precision. [1]

mark_scheme.criterion: Part (b): High precision, because the range / spread (0.02 mm) is very small, showing close agreement among the repeated measurements.

hints: In part (a), range = maximum reading - minimum reading.
In part (b), connect the small range to the definition of precision.
solution: (a) Range = 16.36 mm - 16.34 mm = 0.02 mm. (b) Yes, the readings demonstrate high precision because the range of 0.02 mm is very small, indicating close agreement among repeated measurements.
teacher_walkthrough: (a) Maximum value = 16.36 mm, minimum value = 16.34 mm. Range = 16.36 - 16.34 = 0.02 mm.
(b) Precision is indicated by spread or range. A range of 0.02 mm represents a tiny variation (~0.1%), so the readings demonstrate high precision.

provenance.independence_statement: Authored drill calculating range and justifying precision evaluation.
